rows.local_answer: Sam Bankman-Fried is the individual facing a criminal trial on fraud and conspiracy charges, as reported by both The Verge and TechCrunch. Prosecutors accuse him of misappropriating customer funds for personal gain.
rows.cloud_answer: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is facing a criminal trial on seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy charges.
